I trained as a statistician at ISSEA (Yaoundé), the statistics school of the CEMAC region, where I earned the Analyst Statistician diploma with a specialisation in data science. I am now a Master 1 student in Econometrics-Statistics at the Aix-Marseille School of Economics (AMSE), in a programme taught entirely in English.

## Experience

- **National Institute of Statistics (INS), Cameroon** — end-of-studies internship, 2026. Multidimensional vulnerability of households hosting internally displaced people.
- **Ministry of Finance (MINFI), Cameroon** — internship, 2025. Cocoa production and exports: time-series decomposition and short-term forecasting; a dashboard of agricultural indicators.
- **ISSEA** — survey supervisor (2025) and interviewer (2024).

## Skills

**Statistics & surveys:** sampling design, weighting, questionnaires, PCA, MCA, HCA, composite indices.
**Econometrics:** linear models, logit/probit, ordered logit, time series and forecasting.
**Tools:** R (Shiny, ggplot2), Python (pandas, scikit-learn, Django), SQL, Stata, SPSS, Power BI, LaTeX.

## Languages

French (fluent) · English (fluent) · Mooré (native)
